entities.summary: Blake Edmon Martinez is an American professional football linebacker. Playing college football for the Stanford Cardinal, he was a two-year starter and named to the first-team All-Pac-12 team in 2015. Martinez was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fourth round of the 2016 NFL draft, and played in the NFL for the Packers, New York Giants, and Las Vegas Raiders.
